title: docs(readme): layered architecture diagram, grouped key features, community
body:
## What

Round 2 of homepage polish (follow-up to #2290).

- **Architecture** — replace the ASCII microkernel diagram with a generated layered diagram (`docs/screenshots/layers.png` + editable `.svg`): the ObjectQL / ObjectOS / ObjectUI protocol layers on the microkernel, with "everything else is a plugin" called out. Matches the `How it works` diagram style.
- **Key Features** — consolidate 14 flat bullets into 4 themed groups (AI-native · protocol-first runtime · data & framework reach · governance & built-ins). Same coverage, far less wall-of-text.
- **Community** — add a short section (star nudge · issues · contributing). No Discord/Discussions links — those aren't set up on the repo.

Docs-only; no source code touched.
